harder.prompt_hi: School fair ke pictograph mein har ticket picture 25 tickets sold dikhati hai. Morning row mein 6 pictures aur afternoon row mein 9 hain. Afternoon mein kitne zyada tickets bike?
hints: How many extra pictures are in the afternoon row?
Find the difference in pictures, then use the key.
Extra tickets = (9 − 6) × ___.
75 tickets: three extra pictures each represent 25 tickets.

harder.prompt_en: In a metro-ridership pictograph, each train picture means 40 passengers. Monday shows 3 full pictures and 1 half; Tuesday shows 4 full pictures. How many more passengers does Tuesday show?
harder.prompt_hi: Metro passengers ke pictograph mein har train picture 40 passengers dikhati hai. Monday par 3 poori aur 1 aadhi picture hai; Tuesday par 4 poori pictures hain. Tuesday par kitne zyada passengers hain?
hints: How much of a picture separates the two rows?
Compare pictures before converting them to passengers.
Difference = half of ___ passengers.
20 passengers: Tuesday exceeds Monday by half a picture.

harder.prompt_en: A school wants a pictograph for 18, 30 and 42 students joining three clubs. Choose the largest whole-number scale from these options that needs only full pictures: 1 picture = 4, 6 or 10 students?
harder.prompt_hi: School ko teen clubs ke 18, 30 aur 42 students ka pictograph banana hai. In options mein sabse bada whole-number scale chuno jisme sirf poori pictures lagen: 1 picture = 4, 6 ya 10 students?
hints: Which option divides every club total exactly?
Only full pictures means no remainder for any total.
6 students per picture: it divides all three totals exactly.

openers.prompt_en: A bar graph shows the number of library books borrowed. Its scale reads 0, 8, 16, 24, 32. The comics bar ends halfway between 24 and 32. How many comics were borrowed?
openers.prompt_hi: Library se li gayi books ka bar graph hai. Scale par 0, 8, 16, 24, 32 likha hai. Comics ka bar 24 aur 32 ke bilkul beech mein khatam hota hai. Kitni comics li gayi?
hints: Which two scale marks surround the bar’s end?
Halfway means adding half of one scale step.
The value is 24 + ___ .
28 comics; halfway through a step of 8 adds 4.

openers.prompt_en: You are drawing bars for 16, 24 and 32 minutes spent practising for a school play. Which equal-step scale starting at 0 fits best: steps of 4, 8 or 20 minutes?
openers.prompt_hi: School play ki practice ke 16, 24 aur 32 minutes ke bars banane hain. Zero se shuru hone wala kaunsa equal-step scale sabse theek hai: 4, 8 ya 20 minutes ke steps?
hints: Which option reaches every value exactly?
Choose equal steps that avoid unnecessary marks.
The bars end at the second, third and fourth marks with steps of ___ .
8 minutes; it reaches all three values in four marks.

harder.prompt_en: A bar graph of phone data used has scale marks at 0, 150, 300 and 450 MB. Riya’s bar ends one-third of the way from 300 to 450 MB. How much data did she use?
harder.prompt_hi: Phone data ke bar graph mein scale marks 0, 150, 300 aur 450 MB par hain. Riya ka bar 300 se 450 MB ke beech ka ek-tihai raasta tay karta hai. Usne kitna data use kiya?
hints: How large is the gap between those two marks?
Find one-third of that gap, then add it to the lower mark.
The bar shows 300 + ___ MB.
350 MB; one-third of the 150 MB gap is 50 MB.

harder.prompt_en: A school records 30, 45 and 75 tickets sold at three stalls. For a bar graph starting at 0, which scale gives exact bar heights using the fewest marks: steps of 5, 15 or 25 tickets?
harder.prompt_hi: School ke teen stalls par 30, 45 aur 75 tickets bike. Zero se shuru hone wale bar graph mein kaunsa scale sabhi bars ko exact dikhayega aur sabse kam marks lega: 5, 15 ya 25 tickets ke steps?
hints: Must every total land on a scale mark?
Check each option against all three totals, then count marks.
The chosen step reaches 75 in ___ equal jumps.
15 tickets; all totals fit exactly, using five jumps to 75.

harder.prompt_en: A bar graph of cricket runs has scale marks 0, 30, 60 and 90. Aman’s bar ends halfway between 60 and 90; Kabir’s ends halfway between 30 and 60. How many more runs did Aman score?
harder.prompt_hi: Cricket runs ke bar graph par scale marks 0, 30, 60 aur 90 hain. Aman ka bar 60 aur 90 ke beech, aur Kabir ka 30 aur 60 ke beech khatam hota hai. Aman ne kitne zyada runs banaye?
hints: What value does each halfway point show?
Read both bars before finding their difference.
Subtract the two halfway values: ___ − ___ .
30 runs; the halfway values are 75 and 45.
